body.statement:
For a matroid on a finite ground set \(E\) with rank function \(r_M\), the rank of the union of \(q\) copies is
\[
r_{M^{\vee q}}(E)=\min_{F\subseteq E}\{|E\setminus F|+q\,r_M(F)\}.
\]
For the graphic matroid, \(r_M(F)=|V|-c(F)\).

source.locator: Matroid partition theorem and the union-rank specialization
source.verbatim_statement: The elements of a matroid M can be partitioned into k independent sets if and only if every subset A satisfies |A| <= k r(A).

attestation.note: Verified from the public-domain NBS source-of-record PDF, Journal of Research 69B (1965), Theorem 1 on page 69; the union-rank formula is its standard maximum-cardinality specialization.
